lead: A `.nvst` case whose program branches on the platform is only half-run by `target/debug/nvs.exe`.
body: `/var/tmp/nvs-linux/debug/nvs` is a Linux binary the valgrind leg keeps current, so `wsl.exe -- bash -lc "cd /mnt/<drive>/<repo> && /var/tmp/nvs-linux/debug/nvs test <case>.nvst"` runs the case on Linux with no build. Check its date first: it is as old as the last valgrind sweep and has none of this session's Rust.
